verdict.line: You lose if you E a target that just flashed or walked into their jungler's gank range; you win almost every stand-still trade because Cho'Gath has no way to punish Test of Spirit.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath has zero dashes or gap-closers, so he cannot escape or avoid E (Test of Spirit) once it's in range, and the data confirms it: 51.9% Illaoi win rate over 81 games with a clear solo-kill edge. The matchup is a straightforward test of whether you land E on cooldown while staying out of Q (Rupture) knockup range.

theirWindow.when: Q lands and you're in melee range
theirWindow.what: Rupture pops you up and slows you for the duration, then Feral Scream (W) silences in a cone if you're still close — back off the moment you see the ground tell so you don't eat both back to back.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and E (Test of Spirit) him immediately. He has no dash to dodge it, and your Passive Tentacles will also swing at him while the spirit is out, adding free damage he can't prevent.

start.why: 51.9% win rate over 55 games — the lifesteal and damage let you win extended E trades where he can't fight back.

boots.why: 53.2% win rate over 77 games; the magic resist directly blunts Feral Scream's silence-cone damage and his Rupture's magic damage.

core.why: Armor shred punishes his tankiness and pairs with your Q/E auto-attack resets for sustained DPS.

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.1% win rate pick — Grasp rewards you for walking up and auto-trading every time his Q is down, which is exactly the rhythm this lane runs on.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 57.8% of games (47.6% win rate) — Teleport lets you reset top after shoving with Tentacles and still answer mid/bot since Cho'Gath has no wave-clear tools to punish the recall.

playing.title: E him on cooldown, every time
playing.detail: Test of Spirit (E, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) is unavoidable for him since he has no dash — land it as soon as it's up and walk away if he tries to all-in during the spirit duration.

playing.title: Respect Rupture's slow, not its damage
playing.detail: Q (Rupture, 9s cooldown) knocks up and slows; the real danger is him following it with Feral Scream's cone silence, so step back the instant the ground telegraph appears rather than tanking both.

playing.title: Track his Feast stacks after level 6
playing.detail: Feast (R) deals true damage and grows him on kill, max 6 stacks — if he's eaten 2+ large jungle camps or a kill, his effective HP jumps and your all-in math changes.

playing.title: Use Tentacles to zone, not just damage
playing.detail: Your Passive spawns Tentacles on nearby terrain that swing at anyone near them — position fights so he's forced into their swing range, since he has no way to clear or avoid them.

playing.title: Save R for a punish, not a poke
playing.detail: Leap of Faith (R, 120/95/70/70/70s cooldown) spawns a Tentacle per champion hit — use it only when he's already overextended, since the long cooldown at rank 1 means a wasted cast leaves you without your main kill tool for two minutes.

playing.title: Don't facecheck after Teleport resets
playing.detail: Because this lane leans in your favor, the realistic way you lose is overstaying a shove into an enemy jungler gank — recall or hold vision before pushing past his tower-aggro range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Cho’Gath’s size and lack of movement abilities makes him an easy target for [E]. Harass Cho’Gath often and try to avoid his (Q). Keep in mind that Cho’Gath can instantly kill with (R), so keep an eye out for your health while engaging.
